objective: Prepare the unmerged v0.1.0-rc1 release candidate from accepted work without publishing, pushing, tagging, or weakening any gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Package version is exactly 0.1.0-rc1 and release notes distinguish implemented behavior from future ideas.
Every prior acceptance test, public-safety check, schema check, pack check, and local installation check passes.
No secret, personal identifier, absolute personal path, private-history artifact, payment, ad, telemetry, or unsupported claim is present.
The candidate is ready for Claude review and Codex validation but remains uncommitted to a remote release.
Known limitations and the absence of browser automation are prominent.
stopConditions: Any prior task or required test remains unresolved.
A release action requests credentials, a push, a tag, or publication.
Three attempts fail on the same issue.
The exact Ox model is unavailable or rate-limited.
deliverable: Changed public files and compact release-candidate JSON with version, tests, inventory, limitations, and blockers.
